info.name: saw_wave_plasma_ar
info.description: Sawtooth-colored particle stream — audio-reactive 3D plasma flow. 8 depth layers of particles stream along a tilted axis with curl-noise turbulence. The saw-wave color palette cycles magenta→purple→blue→cyan→green with sharp resets. Bass drives glow intensity, particle size, stream spread, and flow speed. White-hot core hotness near the stream center. Orbiting camera with slow drift.
